name: Harvester HCI Self-Hosted Virtualization
free_limit: Open-source Kubernetes-based hyperconverged infrastructure for bare-metal VM clusters, with integrated virtualization, distributed storage, networking and Rancher integration; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires your own compatible bare-metal servers, disks, networking and operations: Harvester does NOT provide any free hosted virtual machine, bandwidth or cloud credits. Enterprise services/support, hardware and hosting incur separate costs; Apache-2.0 license terms apply.
